items.title: SASSA Facial-Verification Failures Reportedly Contributed to Social Grant Access Disruptions in South Africa
items.summary: South African social grant beneficiaries reportedly encountered repeated failures in SASSA's eLife facial-verification portal. items.summary: Australian patient Rebecca Green reportedly discovered that a post-operative letter sent by her urologist to her GP falsely said she micro-dosed psychedelic mushrooms and suggested this could explain prior kidney bleeding.
